ACKS-IMPORTER.tables.imported: ACKS Importer | imported {tables} rules table(s) from your books into this world ({docs}). Market and hiring automation now uses your book values.

ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.title: Getting Started — ACKS II Content
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.intro: This module reads rules text from your own ACKS II PDFs. The GM connects their books once and imports what the cookbook ships; a book put on the server is then read automatically on every launch, so nobody re-picks files each session.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.gmBody: With your books connected, one click imports everything the cookbook ships: proficiencies & powers, equipment, monsters & NPCs, location journals, roll tables, and rules tables. Safe to run again later — nothing is duplicated.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.importDone: Done — see the chat log and notifications for details.
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.dismiss: Don't open this automatically again (this seat)
ACKS-IMPORTER.gs.settingHint: When unchecked, the Getting Started walkthrough opens on join for this seat until a book has been connected.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.connectWrongBook: that file is {actual}, not {book} — it was not read, so nothing is imported from the wrong book. Connect {actual} on its own, or pick the right file for {book}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.locationSaved: {book}: location remembered on this device. Descriptions stay in memory only.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.locationNameOnly: {book}: this browser can't reopen files on its own, so only the name "{name}" is remembered — you'll be offered it again next session.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.locationNotSaved: {book} is open and readable, but this browser wouldn't let its location be remembered — you'll be asked for the file again next session.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.booksAbsent: Not connected on this seat — connecting would unlock {scope}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectFailed: could not be opened. If the file moved, use Connect Your Book.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectHandle: remembered as {where} — one click unlocks it.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectUrlFailed: could not be read at {where} — has it moved?
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectFile: Last time this was "{name}". This browser can't reopen it on its own — choose it again.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectIncomplete: still not open: {books} — use Connect Your Book if the file moved.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllOpen: every remembered book is already open this session: {books}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.cache.settingName: Keep books open across a page reload (seconds)
ACKS-IMPORTER.cache.settingHint: Foundry reloads often, and on a remote seat every reload used to mean re-picking each PDF. For this many seconds after the page goes away, your books reopen by themselves. It is a bridge across a reload, not a copy of the book: leave the table for longer than this and it empties, as does Forget Books. 0 turns it off.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllUnmatched: couldn't tell which book these are — use the per-book picker for them: {files}
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectFolderDenied: permission was not granted — the folder stays closed.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.folderNoPdfs: no PDFs found in that folder — nothing was read.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.folderNone: none of that folder's PDFs matched a book this module reads — connect the book by picking its file, so you name the pairing yourself.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.folderSkipped: {skipped} other PDF(s) in the folder were left alone (the console names them).
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.statusNote: Books are read live from your files — prose is never stored.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.progressTables: Reading rules tables from your books…
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.abilIntro: {n} abilities available. Books connected this seat: {books}. Abilities always import with their name, classification and page reference; the mechanics and the rules text come from a connected book.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.abilAlias: Its rules text is printed under another entry; it does not stack with that one.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.abilDeprecated: Removed in ACKS II — imports with a caution.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.browseAbilitiesTip: Pick which proficiencies, powers and skills to import, filtered by category and name.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.importAllAbilitiesTip: Import every proficiency, power and skill the cookbook ships, as shared items. Already-imported ones are reused, never duplicated.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.updateAllAbilitiesTip: Refresh every ability in the world — loose items and the copies on actors — against the current cookbook. Ones with no cookbook id are matched by name and adopted.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.collideTitle: Abilities that already have their own text
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.collideIntro: {n} abilit(ies) match a book definition by name only — this module did not create them, and someone has written their descriptions. Updating replaces that text with a page reference. Keeping renames the original out of the way and puts a working reference beside it, so the character holds both.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.collideOverwrite: Replace it with the book reference
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.dynamicStub: {name} — full text: {book}, PDF p. {page}. Connect (or re-connect) your PDF on this seat to read it here.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.browseNote: Uses the book already connected this session; otherwise choose its PDF file (read locally in this browser — never uploaded).
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.browseFound: {n} extraction anchor(s) detected on {book}, PDF p. {page} — tick what to load:
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.browseDone: {n} document(s) created from {book} PDF p. {page} — tags persisted, prose cached on this seat only.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.kind.auto: Auto (MM heading → monster · RR/JJ heading → ability · entry → item)

ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.cookbookAllConfirmSkip: {skipped} already in this world will be skipped.

ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.pruneNone: No stale abilities — every imported ability still has a definition.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.pruneAbilitiesTip: Remove imported abilities whose definition this module no longer ships. Lists them for confirmation first.
ACKS-IMPORTER.tables.languagesApplied: Imported {created} language(s) from your own book.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.registerNote: Your own PDF, read in this browser only — nothing about it is stored or sent. Give it a name yourself: a PDF's own title is often the file it was exported from.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.browseNote: Stat blocks are found by their own labels, so start on any page that has some.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.notOpen: That adventure is not open this session — register it again to reopen the file.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.pastEnd: That is past the last page ({n}).
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.noBlocks: No stat blocks found on page {page}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.reviewNote: Check each reading against the page before importing. Anything the converter would have had to guess is listed as left alone, and nothing is written for it.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.unknownLabels: This page also uses labels the reader does not know: {labels}. Calibrate the adventure to teach them.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.importedUnconverted: Imported {n} creature(s) from “{name}” p.{page} — armour class and attack throw still need the System Compatibility Guide.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.warnForeign: This looks like a stat block from a different game. Read as OSE its armour class would invert, so it cannot be ticked.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.warnMerged: Two stat blocks may have been read as one — the armour class appears twice. It cannot be ticked; narrow the page or import the creatures by hand.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.warnNoGuide: The System Compatibility Guide is not open, so armour class and attack throw will be left for later.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.calibrateNote: These words stand where a label would stand on this page. Say what each one means, and this adventure alone will read them that way.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.nothingToCalibrate: Nothing on this page looks like an unknown label.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.needGuide: Open the ACKS II System Compatibility Guide first — its page 2 carries the conversion.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.converted: Filled in armour class and attack throw on {n} creature(s).
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.nothingToConvert: Nothing is waiting on the guide.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualTitle: Convert a stat block by hand
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualNote: Paste a block and press Read, or just fill the fields in. Each field takes the clause as your own game writes it — the same reader handles both, so anything it learns from a book it also understands here.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualPastePlaceholder: AC 9 [10], HD 1** (4hp), Att 1 × dagger (1d4), THAC0 19 [0], ML 7, AL Chaotic, XP 16
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualNothingPasted: Nothing to read — paste a block first, or fill the fields in yourself.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualUnreadable: Nothing in that text looked like a stat block. Fill the fields in by hand.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualEmpty: Every field is empty — nothing to convert.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualLearned: Understood using wording learned from your books: {list}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualLeftover: Not recognised, and not used: {list}. Move anything you want kept into a field.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualConfirmNote: This is what will be created. Anything the converter would have had to guess is listed as left alone, and nothing is written for it.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.manualMadeUnconverted: Created “{name}” — armour class and attack throw still need the System Compatibility Guide.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.gap.incomplete-save-ro: the printed saving throws make up no complete set
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.gap.not-a-number: the armour class is stated in words, not a figure
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.gap.saves-by-reference: the saving throws are stated as another creature’s

ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.bookDoneUnconverted: Imported {n} creature(s) from {book} — armour class and attack throw still need the System Compatibility Guide.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.bookRefused: {n} entr(ies) did not match this printing and were skipped.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.bookTemplates: {n} of them stat a range of hit dice and became generator actors you can stamp creatures from.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ose.areasDone: {n} keyed area(s) from {book} are now places, nested inside the adventure.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.localNote: Pick every PDF in one go — each file goes to the book it belongs to, matched by name and then by size. Anything that can't be placed is named, and each book below also has its own control.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.localNoteFolder: One permission click on “{name}” re-reads every book in that folder. Or pick PDFs directly — they're matched to books by name, then by size.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllPartial: reopened everything that could be reopened without asking. These still need their own button, one click each: {books}
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfEmpty: No books staged yet. A staged book is read automatically on every launch, by every GM seat, with no file picking at all — add one from its row below once it is open, or copy PDFs into the folder and scan.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfEmptyPlayer: No books are staged on the server yet.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfHeld: Read from the server on every launch — {name}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfRemoved: no longer read from the server. The file itself is still there, at {path}.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfScanNote: Copy your PDFs into {dir} under the Foundry data folder, then scan. Each file is identified by its name and confirmed by opening it; anything that is not a book this module reads is left alone.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfScanDone: now reading {count} book(s) from the server.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfScanNone: nothing new to stage — {skipped} PDF(s) there matched no book.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfNoDir: {dir} does not exist under the Foundry data folder yet. Add a book from its row below, or create the folder and copy PDFs into it.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfUploadFailed: the upload did not complete — nothing was staged.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfNoBytes: this book's file is no longer held in memory — reconnect it, then add it to the server.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.shelfFailed: {name} could not be read from the server.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.forgetConfirm: Drop this browser's remembered book locations and close the books it has open? Books on the server are not affected, and nothing already imported into the world is removed.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.forgetDone: this computer's remembered locations were dropped.
ACKS-IMPORTER.ui.reconnectAllNothing: nothing was waiting — every book this seat knows about is already open.
